unsupported_profiles.reason: Revision 1 deliberately requires closed outward-oriented manifold volumes.
Standard OFF publication fails closed when an EPECK construction is not exactly representable as binary64.
Touch configurations whose union is not a manifold volume are reported as an algorithm failure and produce no output.
